How to Launch a Paid Newsletter: Platform or Self-Hosted?

Start on a hosted platform. It handles payments, paywalls and deliverability, which is most of the work. Self-host once a percentage of your subscription revenue costs more than a flat infrastructure bill, or once you need control the platform won't give you.
